offering_description.value: Owns, develops and manages logistics warehouses and distribution facilities, leasing them to businesses worldwide. It earns rent from its property portfolio and fees from developing buildings and managing investment funds.

primary_products.value: logistics warehouses; distribution centers; light industrial buildings; cold storage facilities

primary_services.value: property management; build-to-suit development; lease administration; solar and energy services

end_markets.value: e-commerce; third-party logistics; retail; manufacturing; food and beverage

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: rent paid by tenants occupying warehouses and distribution buildings; project or contract: build-to-suit development of buildings for specific tenants; service fees: property management and leasing services for buildings; commissions or management fees: fees for managing investment funds that own logistics properties
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; project or contract; service fees; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs a large portfolio of warehouses leased to tenants; service provider: develops and manages buildings for investors and occupiers
